name: knot_task_fanout
description: Divide-and-Conquer: Atomically post a batch of parallel subtasks and an optional barrier task that stays blocked until all subtasks finish.

barrier_task.description: Optional aggregator task to execute after all subtasks complete. Hub will auto-inject a matrix of subtask results into its prompt.

tasks.description: List of subtask objects with keys: prompt (required), title (optional), target_plane (optional), lease_ttl (optional).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds when wait_barrier is true (default: 300).

wait_barrier.description: If true, blocks until the barrier reducer task finishes execution (or times out). Default is false.
